fields.title: 📖 Applying verses about the kuffār to Muslims
fields.body:
🖋️ **ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿUmar** said:

> ***“They went to verses that were revealed about the kuffār and applied them to the believers.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The Ghulāt read proofs, but they apply them wrongly. Not every āyah about the kuffār may be applied to Muslims.

immutable.source: 📝 al-Bukhārī, Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī, Kitāb Istitābat al-Murtaddīn, Bāb: Qatl al-Khawārij wa’l-mulḥidīn baʿda iqāmat al-ḥujjah ʿalayhim; Taʿlīq von Ibn ʿUmar.
